mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 61 degrees with overcast skies at the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are currently seeing a waning crescent moon.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is offering free 30-minute rides on their tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail, and don't forget that the City also has a rain barrel rebate policy to help residents conserve water.
There is a busy schedule today with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena, plus Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening tomorrow.
Regarding local safety, on July 31, a police officer conducted a traffic stop for equipment violations which led to the arrest of a driver for an O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Snickers Swirl. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM, so you can plan your visit accordingly.
